notes.title: Halloween Candy Hunt 2019
notes.content:
[b]Spooky month is here and to celebrate, we've pumped some Halloween into the Void!!![/b]


Decorate your Galileo Device with 3 new medals which you can earn by killing, more killing, and eating.... the way Halloween is meant to be celebrated! 



Visit our brand new Armory and Medal Display for more details!



We've also put the game on sale, so grab it for 50% off today!! And on behalf of Monkehs Studios, [b]HAPPY HALLOWEEN!!![/b]
